content.content:
1. License, per prerequisite: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite, applied once against each id in depends_on. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element and the prerequisite it contradicts; the dependent must survive both legs, item 2's line included.

2. The check-level line, stated and additive: the dependent covers a check that could not itself run — one line for it, alongside the per-failure lines — and that line keeps the same three positions as a per-failure line: the check's name, then a stand-in in the id position marking that no single change or node is implicated, then the evidence the check produced. Fail if that case is left uncovered; if it is folded into a per-failure line, or given more or fewer than those three positions; if the id position is left empty or carries a node or change id; or if the third position is dropped or carries a reason instead of the check's evidence. Which glyph marks the stand-in, and how the evidence is spelled, are the dependent's to fix — this item requires only that the position mark the absence of one implicated id. An example of a check that cannot run is not a narrowing; a rule that holds only for that example is (item 3). Fail in the other direction if a prerequisite named in depends_on already states this line: the edge then licenses nothing new — name the prerequisite and the clause.

3. The line form is general to a check that could not run: fail if the dependent keys the case to one named check, one named tool, or one named way of failing to run, so the line shape does not hold for a check that could not itself run; name the element.

4. Nothing unrecorded decided: fail if applying items 1-3 needs a rule the dependent and the prerequisites in depends_on do not record — the status the invocation returns when a check cannot run, whether such a case refuses the invocation, how many checks there are or which of them can fail to run, or the evidence's own content — and name the missing rule instead of deciding it. This item decides none of these; it checks only that the line shape is stated and sound.
content.rationale: The check-level line is where the dependent's failure report meets a check that could not itself run: it must be a line on the same stdout report, so svxynnwk's channel and line discipline and mruplukn's status still govern it, while its id position is what the dependent does not yet have. The criterion pins that addition and only it — the refusal, the status, which checks exist and what the evidence holds stay with the nodes that own them, and no crossing is named. Both prerequisites and the dependent are requirement sentences, so the cell is the matrix default (structured to structured): the gate form plus a flag to extend the matrix. The refinement adds no prerequisite, so both subject edges of the use remain covered by the pair named here.
